independence_policy: Method name is not evidence independence. Shared implementation foundations are declared on every result.
known_limitations: Spectral subtraction and Wiener filtering share STFT and low-energy noise-profile preprocessing.
NMF component identity is ambiguous and uses an explicit stationary-component heuristic.
Harmonic/percussive output is a partial component and is not a complete speech reconstruction.
Spectral repair is experimental and requires an explicit damage mask; interpolated regions remain synthetic support.
